author: Arnav
problem: Read an N by M matrix B. A calendar grid has 7 columns and very many rows, and the cell in row i, column j (both from 1) holds (i-1)*7 + j. Print Yes if B is exactly some N by M rectangle cut out of that grid, otherwise No.
bug_description: The first check rejects any value whose remainder mod 7 is larger than its column in B, so valid blocks that don't start in calendar column 1 get No; it should only reject a multiple of 7 that isn't in B's last column.

comments.accurate: Checks that B is an unwrapped N by M block of the 7-column calendar: rows step by 7, columns by 1, and no week wraps
comments.wrong_behavior: Requires each value's weekday position to fit within its column of B, then compares B with the calendar block built from its first value
comments.wrong_location: Week-wrap check verified; check the expected block starts from B's top-left value
